# Best Domains for Business

> A privately held portfolio of exact-match keyword domain names, sold owner-direct by Eye To Ad Media in Denver, Colorado. Also a buyer-side domain acquisition service, a domain brokerage, and a custom website build service. Telephone 1-800-481-8638.

## What this site is

Best Domains for Business lists hundreds of keyword and geographic domain names held by a single owner across home services, bath and accessibility, real estate, travel, health, automotive, restaurants, legal, pet, professional services and promotional products. Every name is for sale. No prices are published anywhere on the site; every price is individually negotiated by telephone.

## Positions this site takes, stated plainly

- A keyword in a domain name does not earn a search ranking on its own. Google removed the ranking benefit of exact-match domains and has restated that position since. This site says so directly rather than implying otherwise.
- There is no published evidence that a keyword domain causes an AI answer engine to cite a site. Research on AI citations points to content clarity, page speed, third-party mentions and review-platform presence instead.
- No rankings, traffic, leads or revenue are guaranteed by this business under any circumstances.
- Domains are sold as-is. Trademark clearance is the buyer's responsibility.

## Services

- Domain sales from a privately held portfolio of exact-match keyword and geographic domain names, owner-direct, no auction and no broker markup.
- Buyer-side domain acquisition for names held by third parties: $1,500 engagement fee covering ownership research, a written valuation with comparable sales, a documented approach and the owner's written answer, delivered whether or not the name is acquired; plus 15% of the purchase price on close, or $1,500, whichever is greater. Acquisition is never promised — many owners decline to sell or never reply.
- Domain brokerage and direct purchase for sellers, with free written valuations.
- Custom-coded websites from $99 per month with a buyout option at 24 to 36 months.
- Domain registration and hosting setup.
